payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the lower performance on Vikidia-FR compared to Newsela-ES is likely due to differences in content diversity and the number of reading levels, which affect ranking metrics.

claims.text: Vikidia-FR has more diverse content compared to Newsela-ES, which has content from the same domain as Newsela-EN, potentially impacting performance.

The number of reading levels in Vikidia-FR is fewer, making it more susceptible to poor ranking performance compared to Newsela-ES.
